name: Aria Digital Twin (ADT)
tagline: 236 Aria sequences in 2 digitized indoor scenes with per-frame 6-DoF poses for 398 objects, depth, instance masks, gaze and mocap skeletons.

annotations.format: CSV (trajectory, 2D/3D boxes, object poses, gaze), JSON (instances, skeletons), VRS (depth, segmentation, synthetic video)
annotations.coverageNote: Ground truth is generated for every frame of all sequences; skeleton files exist only where a wearer wore the mocap suit.

object_boxes.note: 2D boxes per instance on RGB and both SLAM cameras, with visibility ratio

body_pose.note: OptiTrack skeleton markers + joints (Skeleton_*.json) for suited wearers

camera_pose.note: aria_trajectory.csv 6-DoF device pose; MPS SLAM trajectories

depth.note: Metric depth (mm) for all three camera streams in depth_images.vrs

scene_3d.note: Digital-twin object meshes (5 mm accuracy); MPS semi-dense points

annotations.sample:
# scene_objects.csv (6-DoF object pose per timestamp; -1 = static)
object_uid,timestamp[ns],t_wo_x[m],t_wo_y[m],t_wo_z[m],q_wo_w,q_wo_x,q_wo_y,q_wo_z

# 2d_bounding_box.csv
stream_id,object_uid,timestamp[ns],x_min[pixel],x_max[pixel],y_min[pixel],y_max[pixel],visibility_ratio[%]

# instances.json (per instance)
{"instance_id": IID1, "instance_name": "XXXX", "prototype_name": "XXXX", "category": "XXXX",
 "motion_type": "static/dynamic", "instance_type": "object/human", "rigidity": "rigid/deformable",
 "canonical_pose": {"up_vector": [x, y, z], "front_vector": [x, y, z]}}

samples.caption: ADT overview: real Aria frames alongside synthetic renders, depth, masks and object poses
